name: Metal Fighter Miku
original_name: メタルファイター　ＭＩＫＵ
source:
In the year 2061 A.D., Neo Pro-Wrestling, a form of wrestling that allows for armour and other enhancements, is rapidly growing in popularity. In this, Miku, a young flighty girl is set to join her friends as the tag team known as the Pretty Four.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metal_Fighter_Miku]wikipedia[/url]]
